statuses.q: What do the tracking statuses mean?
statuses.intro: Each shipment shows one status, based on the latest milestone we have on file.
statuses.pending: Your case has been opened; we're waiting for departure or filing details.
statuses.inTransit: The cargo has departed or the ISF has been filed, and it has not arrived yet.
statuses.customs: The cargo has arrived and is waiting for customs release.
statuses.atPort: The cargo has arrived and customs has released it — it's waiting for pickup.
statuses.outForDelivery: The container has been picked up and is on its way to the delivery address.
statuses.delivered: The cargo has been delivered, or the empty container has been returned.
statuses.completed: Customs-brokerage-only file: customs has released the cargo after arrival and our work is complete.
statuses.exception: The shipment is marked urgent — action is required. Please check the details or contact us.

lfd.q: What is the Last Free Day (LFD) and how is it flagged?
lfd.intro: The Last Free Day is the final day a container can stay at the terminal without demurrage or storage charges. We highlight it by how close it is:

normal.label: More than 2 days
normal.text: Normal — enough time to schedule pickup.

warning.label: 0–2 days left
warning.text: Warning — pickup should be arranged now.

overdue.label: Past LFD
overdue.text: Overdue — demurrage or storage charges may be accruing.

lfd.tip: Tip: pick up before the LFD to avoid demurrage and storage fees.

quotes.ltl: Enter origin, destination, weight, dimensions and any accessorials to get instant rates from multiple carriers.
quotes.drayage: Choose the port or rail ramp, the delivery ZIP and the container type to see drayage pricing.

points.1: Rates are based on current market conditions and may change until you book.
points.2: If a carrier shows "Rate not available", use Request Rate or contact us and we'll quote it manually.

hts.q: How accurate are HTS duty estimates?
hts.intro: HTS Search shows estimated duty rates to help you plan. The final assessment is made by U.S. Customs and may differ.

points.1: Additional duties (such as Section 301) apply only when you select them — please review which ones apply to your goods.
points.2: Exclusions and exemptions are not calculated in the estimate.
points.3: Not sure about a classification? Ask our customs team from the HTS page.

addressBook.q: Can I save addresses I use often?
addressBook.a: Yes. Save shippers, consignees and delivery locations in your Address Book and reuse them when requesting quotes.

language.q: How do I switch the portal language?
language.a: Use the language button in the top bar to switch between English and Chinese. Your choice is remembered on this browser.
